name: Qube Browser 0.5.1
notes:
0.5.1
Fixed:
* Updates no longer fail right after you press Update

0.5.0
New:
* Notes: text notes and whiteboards, as tabs and in the Library
* Command bar with 60 commands, and Ask AI
* Qube Spark: chat with Claude or ChatGPT
* Streaming Space: a Space with a tile per streaming service
* Little Qube: links from other apps open in a small window
* Spotify as music source, next to Apple Music
* Per profile: search engine, download folder and extensions
* Full keyboard and Narrator support
* Settings in the Windows 11 style
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Improved:
* Tabs not used for an hour are unloaded to save memory
* Windows from your last session reopen at start

Fixed:
* Permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
summary: Notes, a new command bar, a Streaming Space, and support for PCs without a graphics card.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.9.4
mac.notes:
Changed:

* Closing a pinned tab removes it (Command-Shift-T brings it back) instead of turning it into an ordinary tab; off its page, the minus still brings it back to its page
* A link you open in a new tab from a Today tab lands right under that tab
* Sidebar text takes on your Space's colour as Arc's does, a little deeper and more colourful
* A pinned tab away from its page shows a bolder slash, spaced as Arc's
* Sidebar rows are half a point shorter, as Arc's

Fixed:

* Streams that draw their own pointer (cursor: none) no longer show the Mac's arrow on top of it
mac.summary: The sidebar looks more like Arc's, pinned tabs close for real, and links from a tab open right under it.
